mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1050 and retail sales below 380000 million dollars indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings growth forecasts and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1050 and RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 110.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) increase cost of capital, reducing equity valuation multiples and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, increasing corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth above 0.5% and unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% per annum signals rising price pressures, eroding real corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0.
